scope: Experimental sequential control and target SQL revocation on pinned PostgreSQL. Actual coordinator SIGKILL between commits, retry, target tombstones, absent/closed targets and OID replacement tested. Not an atomic cutoff, production integration or replay authorization.

host headroom checked before bounded probe

same database OID cannot substitute a different cluster

delayed target registration cannot resurrect old token
repeated complete revocation preserves evidence identity

closed target remains closed

active control token cannot bind a closed target
revocation after binding prevents delayed registration
